app.name: LSD Dream Emulator
app.long_description:
Full English Translation for LSD - Dream Emulator (PS1)
This is an English translation patch for the game LSD - Dream Emulator created by Mr.Nobody & Arcanearia.
The translation covers all of the 48 text-dreams (most of them based in the dream journal 'Lovely Sweet Dream') and the main menu.
Text dreams were based also on the english translation of Badcafe, Puptoon, Chia and other collaborators from the LSD: Dream Emulator Wiki website.
Emulator Features: - 240p support! - Posibility of enabling/disabling Interlaced (480i) mode, Bilinear/Trap/Deflicker filters. - Memory Card enabling/disabling support. - Multiple languages support. - GameCube Controller support. - Wii U Pro Controller support. - Wii U GamePad Controller support through WiiVC injects. - Wii Classic Controller and Pro support. - Nintendo Classic Mini Controllers support (NES / SNES).
